APPROVE
The extractions remove about 16 points of nesting-weighted complexity, which leaves `ChangeFilters` around 13; moving the `reported.Add` check into the lazy `Where` after `DistinctBy` keeps the same filtering order and side effects; and the helpers are a direct cut-and-paste of the original logic. I couldn't find the repository here, so the build is unverified: I couldn't confirm that the helper parameter types `CiChangeFilter`, `TestInvocation` and `JsInventory.Inventory` match the actual declarations.
